bibl.title: The Founder of Manichaeism. Rethinking the Life of Mani.
bibl.seg: Iain Gardner, The Founder of Manichaeism. Rethinking the Life of Mani.
Cambridge, Cambridge University Press, 2020, xxiv-142 pp. ISBN 978-1-108-49907-1. £ 75.
C.R. par Manfred Hutter, Klio 104 (2022) pp. 411-415.
bibl.note: Foreword. - Preface. - 1. Introduction to the Many Lives of Mani. - 2. Mani's Background and Early Life. - 3. Mani's Career as the "Apostle of Jesus Christ". - 4. Mani's Death. - Appendices: Appendix A. The Dualistic Basis of Mani's Thought; - Appendix B. The Community in Late-Antique Egypt and the Village of Kellis; - Appendix C. Some Comments on the Manichaean Kephalaia and the ‘Jesus-Book’ in the Chester Beatty Codex. - References. Index.
